“É”lan rests by the quay.


Breakwater faces the inlet.

HiddenKestrel passes across the harbor.

(Figural) wades toward the salt meadow.

Reeds follow the banks.

Flock gathers near the shallows. Soon the winding path brings the distant lamp into view along the banks of the inlet.

Marsh opens behind the trees. After the narrow channel the gulls follow small waves toward the harbor mouth.
